name: Single Responsive Image Formatter
description: Provides responsive formatter for images that displays only first value of multi-valued image field
project_description:
This module provides field formatters for Image, Media and Responsive image fields that display only the first value of a multi-valued field. It is useful when you configure teaser or listing displays and don't need to show every image. 

 How to use? 
 Just install this module as usual, enable it and choose "Single image formatter", "Single media thumbnail", "Single rendered entity" or "Single responsive image" in the "Manage display" tab of your entity.

 "Single media thumbnail", "Single rendered entity" and "Single responsive image" are contained in submodules. You should enable the appropriate submodule to use them. The media thumbnail formatter can optionally render the original media source image through a responsive image style instead of the thumbnail.
